request.subject: TERRAIN:GRASS

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: straight top-down view of flat ground filling the whole canvas edge to edge, no perspective, no horizon, no lighting gradient.

Class: calm terrain ground for a strategy map, less saturated than the pieces placed on it, flat colour fills with two or three close tones, low detail, a few small features scattered evenly, the same everywhere with no single focal object. The ground continues past all four edges of the image.
layers.negative: border, frame, hedge, outline around the image, vignette, dark corners, light spot, lighting gradient, path, road, buildings, characters, people, perspective, horizon, red, tile edge, square island, neon, oversaturated

layers.text: Subject: a wide flat meadow of short, slightly withered lawn grass seen from directly above, one even calm cool grey-green base colour with small darker grass tufts scattered evenly and sparsely all over, nothing else.

layers.negative: trees, bushes, shrubs, rocks, animals, people, path, road, skulls, bones, graves, mushrooms, purple
